# Plurgasm

> A US-focused rave & electronic music culture hub — festival calendar, rave brand directory, creator spotlights, PLUR culture, and harm-reduction/safety info.

Plurgasm is a guide to the American rave and electronic music scene. It maps out the festivals worth traveling for, curates a directory of community-vetted rave brands (clothing, kandi, shoes, accessories, and more), spotlights creators and influencers in the scene, and publishes news and culture writing on PLUR, festival guides, gear, fashion, and safety. The site is solo-built and centers harm reduction and looking out for each other on the dancefloor.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://plurgasm.com/): Landing page with featured festivals, brands, categories, creators, and the latest from the community.
- [Festival Calendar](https://plurgasm.com/calendar): Full US festival calendar with map view, plus vibe, region, and Near Me filters.
- [Rave Brands](https://plurgasm.com/#brands): Directory of rave clothing, kandi, shoes, accessory, and event brands, filterable by category and item type.
- [Shop by Category](https://plurgasm.com/#categories): Browse brands by category — fem/male clothing, shoes, accessories, kandi, jerseys & merch, and events.
- [Creators](https://plurgasm.com/social): Directory of rave-scene creators and influencers to follow across platforms.
- [Social Spotlight](https://plurgasm.com/#social): Featured creators highlighted on the homepage.
- [Blog](https://plurgasm.com/blog): Rave news and culture — festival guides, PLUR history, gear, fashion, and safety.
- [Safety & Harm Reduction](https://plurgasm.com/safety): Harm-reduction and festival safety information for ravers.
- [Partner With Us](https://plurgasm.com/partners): Information for brands and creators looking to partner with Plurgasm.
- [Submit a Brand or Festival](https://plurgasm.com/submit): Suggest a rave brand or festival to add to the directory.
- [Write for Us](https://plurgasm.com/submit-article): Pitch or submit an article for the Plurgasm blog.

Electronic music is everywhere right now and video games might be one of the most interesting places it is showing up.

If you are new to the bass music world, the subgenres can feel overwhelming. - [The History of PLUR: Where It Actually Came From](https://plurgasm.com/blog-post?id=post-008): Peace, Love, Unity, Respect. Four words that became the backbone of an entire culture. But where did PLUR actually come from, who coined it, and how did it travel from illegal New York warehouse parties to becoming the defining philosophy of global rave culture?

- [EDC Las Vegas 2026: What to Expect at the 30th Anniversary](https://plurgasm.com/blog-post?id=post-002): EDC turns 30 in 2026 and it's shaping up to be the biggest edition ever. 9 stages, 200+ artists, 500,000 headliners under the electric sky of Las Vegas. Here's what you need to know.
- [PLUR 101: A Beginner's Guide to Rave Culture](https://plurgasm.com/blog-post?id=post-003): New to raving? Here's everything you need to know about the culture, etiquette, kandi trading, and why PLUR isn't just a slogan: it's how we actually look out for each other on the dancefloor.
- [Electric Forest 2026: Why This is Unlike Any Other Festival](https://plurgasm.com/blog-post?id=post-004): Electric Forest is not just a festival. It's a world built inside a Michigan pine forest. ILLENIUM, GRiZ, and Subtronics headline a 4-day experience that is genuinely unlike anything else.

## About

Plurgasm is a solo-built directory and culture hub focused on the US festival and electronic music scene. It is grounded in PLUR — Peace, Love, Unity, Respect — and prioritizes community recommendations and harm reduction over hype.
